tdm.text: The Meditation Realm is where Jace arrives with Loot and Vraska on Tarkir to reshape the Multiverse, and where Narset and Elspeth find him through an Omenpath and learn that he escaped compleation by force of will.

When Narset empties her mind so the realm stops fighting, it reveals Ugin and a chained dragon, and Ugin explains that he made the realm a prison for his brother, Nicol Bolas, though he says he cannot help against the dragonstorms.

Jace seizes the gem between Ugin's horns, explaining that the realm is a hub of reality he can mold by will to save Vraska from what Phyrexia did, but when Vraska appears and tells him to stop, the strain breaks him and the realm begins to unmake itself.

Jace shatters like glass as the emptiness rolls over him, Narset carries Loot as they flee, and Bolas laughs as his fetters come undone and he and Ugin vanish into the nothing as the realm burns away.
